description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans runtime, specifically testing the behavior of the consistent ring implementation in a silo cluster. It defines test classes and methods to verify server failures, joins, and ring coverage, utilizing mock objects and helper classes.

classes.name: RingTests_Standalone
classes.description: A test class containing multiple test methods to verify the behavior of the Orleans consistent ring in various scenarios such as basic operation, failures, joins, and mixed conditions.

classes.name: FakeSiloStatusOracle
classes.description: A mock implementation of ISiloStatusOracle used in tests to simulate silo statuses and notify subscribers.

classes.name: RangeBreakable
classes.description: A helper class to manage and verify coverage of ranges, used in ring verification to ensure no overlaps or gaps.

methods.name: RingStandalone_Basic
methods.description: Tests basic ring creation and verification with a fixed number of servers.

methods.name: RingStandalone_Failures
methods.description: Tests ring behavior under various server failure scenarios.

methods.name: RingStandalone_Joins
methods.description: Tests ring behavior when servers join the cluster.

methods.name: RingStandalone_Mixed
methods.description: Tests mixed join and failure scenarios.

methods.name: TestChurn
methods.description: Helper method to simulate failures and joins, then verify ring integrity.

methods.name: CreateServers
methods.description: Creates a set of mock servers with unique silo addresses.

methods.name: Combine
methods.description: Merges two sets of servers, updating each with references to the other.

methods.name: RemoveServers
methods.description: Removes specified servers from the ring and updates remaining servers about failures.

methods.name: VerifyRing
methods.description: Verifies that the ring covers the entire range without overlaps.

methods.name: CompareSiloAddressesByHash
methods.description: Compares two silo addresses based on their consistent hash code.
